correctness.rationale: Under normalized induced-coalition distance welfare, each proper connected coalition in Cn is a path arc with welfare F(k)=2(H_k-1). Splitting a disconnected coalition weakly increases welfare, and any singleton admits a strictly improving adjacent merge. For k>=5, F(k)-F(k-3)<=47/30<F(3), so only arcs of lengths 2,3,4 maximize proper partitions. With n=2a+3b+4c, the block welfare is 5n/9-(2a+c)/18; residue arithmetic enumerates exactly the minimizing block multisets. The cycle grand coalition contributes Qn=2H_floor((n-1)/2)+(2/n) 1_(n even), and Q_6=W_6=10/3 with W_n>Q_n for n>=7; n<=5 grand strictly best. Cut placements yield N_6=4 and for n>=7 counts 3,n,n(q+1)/2 in the mod-3 classes. Independently exhaustive *unrestricted* set partition enumeration of cycles n=3..8 agrees; no connected-partition shortcut in this independent check.
